intent: Editable field for entering and editing a text value inline, with an optional label, hint, and inline affordances.
guidance: The field is value-controlled: `defaultValue` renders empty, so bind `value` + `onChange` to show a value. There is no resting border — a ring appears only on focus or a non-default `variant`. Set `variant` (error/success/warning) to color the focus ring and the hint together. Use `leadingIcon`/`trailingIcon` for the 24px icon columns, and reach for the numeric, combo, or color siblings in this module rather than stretching this field to non-text values.
use_when: Entering or editing free text: a name, label, or URL.
A single-line field wanting a label above and/or a hint below.
Longer notes — set `multiline` for the textarea layout.
dont_use_when: Editing a number with scrub/step — use NumericInput.
Choosing from a fixed list — use Dropdown/ComboInput.
Picking a color or fill — use ColorInput.

slots.label: Field label above the control.
slots.inlineLabel: Text/glyph in the leading column when no leadingIcon.
slots.inlineDropdown: Embedded value + chevron pill hugging the right edge.

tokens.note: Field height (h-20/24/32px), font size/leading (text-9/11/13px), weight (font-450), and tracking are hardcoded values, not size/type tokens. ColorInput in this module defaults `color` to a #hex literal (#ff24bd).

a11y.label: Associates <label htmlFor> with the input id (useId); pass `label`, or give the numeric/combo variants an aria-label.
a11y.keyboard: Native text editing; numeric variants add ArrowUp/ArrowDown step, Enter commit, Escape cancel.
a11y.focus: Focus ring bound to the focus-ring token from onFocus state (autofocus falls back to :focus-within); disabled/read-only apply cursor-not-allowed and disabled drops opacity.
a11y.note: Numeric variants render role="spinbutton" with min/max/step; the base text field uses the native textbox role with no role attribute.
